title: Hunters Creek Park
TrailPulse — Local Trail Conditions
text:
Updated daily. Conditions are estimated from weather data and soil moisture models — not a substitute for official trail closures.




Hunters Creek Park


Elma, NY


1,000 acres of hardwood forest in Elma, NY with 18 miles of multi-use trails popular for hiking, mountain biking, and winter Nordic skiing.


Hiking · Mountain Biking · Trail Running · Nordic Skiing · Snowshoeing




Trail condition data sourced from Open-Meteo, USGS National Water Information System, and NWS. Not affiliated with Erie County Parks or any land management authority.
